theme: The Last Mile — From Demo-Ready to Production-Ready

1_regression_protection.definition: Automated test suites that verify invariants across future refactors, driver updates, and multi-tenant boundary changes in any execution environment.
1_regression_protection.analogy: Like building high guardrails and impact barriers along a mountain road rather than just driving carefully on a sunny afternoon.

2_onboarding_documentation.definition: Clear, precise API specifications, RBAC hierarchy diagrams, and integration patterns enabling another engineer to extend roles or endpoints without reverse-engineering code.
2_onboarding_documentation.analogy: Like leaving clear wiring schematics inside an electrical breaker box so the next electrician does not cause a short circuit.

3_automated_ci_pipeline.definition: Hermetic continuous integration pipeline executing all unit, integration, and security tests on every commit, emitting binary green/red signals without manual interventions.
3_automated_ci_pipeline.analogy: Like an automated factory assembly line scanner that halts the belt if any component deviates by even a millimeter.

4_defensive_deployment_strategy.definition: Versioned releases with backward compatibility, zero-downtime database migrations, canary rollouts, and verified instant rollback runbooks.
4_defensive_deployment_strategy.analogy: Like a trapeze artist always performing with a certified safety net securely rigged underneath.
